$schema_purpose: Specification record for the Router Agent (#5). The RUNTIME is the pure-Python guard-clause function route() in app/agents/router.py; this file is the maintained documentation of those rules (mirrored by routing_rules.generated.json). Rules are evaluated in ascending priority; the first matching guard wins. applied_rule_id in agent_output references the rule ids below.
supersedes: 1.1.0 — adds the post-RAG policy resolution rules R030A/R030B; see CHANGELOG.md
evaluation_order: ascending priority; first matching guard wins; categories are mutually exclusive so only the global pre-empts (R001-R003) cross-cut category dispatch

routing_philosophy.principle: LLM describes, code decides. Routing is fully deterministic.
routing_philosophy.confidence: Classifier confidence and validator revised_confidence are LOGGED, NEVER gated on (decision 2026-06-06). The v1.0.0 low_confidence rule (confidence < 0.75) is removed.
routing_philosophy.deterministic_backbone: The deterministic Audit (audit_finding / consistency) is the routing backbone for booking_notification.
routing_philosophy.validator_effect: The Validator flag is a CONTRIBUTING signal, not a sole gate: it only changes an otherwise-clean booking_notification (clean + flagged -> audit_only_with_note). For hard-escalation categories the route stays category-driven.
routing_philosophy.category_primary: Each email is exactly one category; audit/validator/risk signals are modifiers WITHIN a category branch, never global overrides of a category escalation.

rules.condition: schema_valid is False (no usable LLM output)
booking_notification AND audit_finding == clean AND validator flagged
booking_notification AND audit_finding == clean AND not flagged
policy question AND kb_answerable is True (post-RAG)
policy question AND kb_answerable is False (post-RAG)
no rule matched (defensive; categories are exhaustive)

decision_flags.description: Computed in build_router_signals() and attached to every result for the dashboard / output context (not used to pick the action directly).
decision_flags.outbound_action_required: yes if expects_human_response == yes OR audit_finding in {missing_fields, suspected_error} OR urgency_signal in {urgent, sensitive_complaint}
decision_flags.requires_internal_system: yes if category in {booking_change_or_cancellation, payment_billing_or_rate_issue, inventory_availability_or_stop_sales, system_or_channel_delivery_exception} OR audit_finding in {missing_fields, suspected_error} OR (service_or_information_inquiry AND request_type not in {policy_or_general_question, withdrawal_or_acknowledgment})
decision_flags.rag_required: yes if category == service_or_information_inquiry AND request_type == policy_or_general_question

rag_answerable_resolution.description: kb_answerable is NOT known at routing time. Policy questions are routed to draft_reply_with_rag as a CANDIDATE (rag_required=true). The RAG Agent (#6) runs after the Router and resolves the final outcome.

rules.if: retrieval empty OR best score < threshold

rag_answerable_resolution.threshold_note: kb_answerable_threshold default 0.65; RECALIBRATE for the BGE-M3 embedding model with a RAG eval set. Score = 1 - cosine_distance over normalized embeddings.

validation_status.result: 100% schema-valid; full coverage (no R024_BN_OTHER or R999_FALLBACK fired); category/action distributions consistent with documented shares.
validation_status.note: Routing logic validated independently of the separate (upstream) extraction-completeness issue.
